      "automated": true,
      "risk": "medium",
      "addresses": [
        "php-version-eol"
      ],

      "scoreAfter": 53

        "Migrate to PDO or mysqli with prepared statements.",

        "Use PDO prepared statements with bound parameters instead of building SQL strings.",
        "Use password_hash and password_verify with the default algorithm.",
